title: A Message About the School Trip

lines.text: Hello, this is Ms Pérez from Colegio Nuevo Sol. This message is for the parents of Class five A.
Tomorrow, Tuesday, we're going on a school trip to the science museum.
Students arrive at the school at seven thirty, not at eight o'clock.
Please give your child a packed lunch and a bottle of water. Students wear the sports uniform.
The bus returns at three o'clock.
Please sign the permission letter and send it tomorrow.
If you have a question, call the school on five five five, zero one nine nine. Thank you!
